verdict.rationale: UKVI itself publishes visa processing times on gov.uk. It maintains a 'Visa processing times: applications outside the UK' page with dated change notes, plus an online service that tells applicants when to expect a decision. However, the evidence does not show processing times listed specifically for the Innovator Founder route or for in-country extension/switch applications, so coverage of 'my transaction type' is only partial. missing for 10: explicit per-route processing times for the Innovator Founder visa, published times for inside-UK extend/switch applications, independent or hands-on corroboration that the figures are current.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: use the online service to check your visa processing time. This will tell you when you can expect a decision.
Processing times are a first-class published surface ("Visa processing times: applications outside the UK"), maintained with dated change notes
